CmdhLimits.label: CmdhLimits
CmdhLimits.description: This Object represents limits for CMDH related parameter values.

Order.label: Order
Order.description: Contains index indicating in which order the concerned CmdhLimits Object Instance will be treated by the CSE to determine a value for the limit parameters.

RequestOrigin.label: RequestOrigin
RequestOrigin.description: List of zero or more Local AE-IDs, App-IDs, or the strings "localAE" or "thisCSE"

RequestContext.label: RequestContext
RequestContext.description: Represents the Dynamic Context condition under which CMDH parameter limits defined inside the concerned CmdhLimits Object Instance is applicable.

RequestContextNotificatio.label: RequestContextNotificatio
RequestContextNotificatio.description: Contains true/false flag indicating whether or not notification procedures apply.

RequestCharacteristics.label: RequestCharacteristics
RequestCharacteristics.description: Represents conditions pertaining to the request itself, (e.g. the requested Response Type  ) than needs to be matched

LimitsEventCategory.label: LimitsEventCategory
LimitsEventCategory.description: Allowed values for the Event Category parameter in a request of any of the Originators indicated in the requestOrigin attribute.

LimitsRequestExpTime_.label: LimitsRequestExpTime
LimitsRequestExpTime_.description:
Defines a range of values for the Request Expiration Time parameter for a request of any Originator indicated in the requestOrigin Resource
Inst 0 : minTime
Inst 1:  maxTime

LimitsResultExpTime.label: LimitsResultExpTime
LimitsResultExpTime.description:
Defines a range of values for the Result Expiration Time parameter for a request of any Originator indicated in the requestOrigin Resource
Inst 0 : minTime
Inst 1:  maxTime

LimitsOptExpTime.label: LimitsOptExpTime
LimitsOptExpTime.description:
Defines a range of values for the Operation Expiration Time parameter for a request of any Originator indicated in the requestOrigin Resource
Inst 0 : minTime
Inst 1:  maxTime

LimitsRespPersistence.label: LimitsRespPersistence
LimitsRespPersistence.description:
Defines a range of values for the Result Persistence parameter for a request of any Originator indicated in the requestOrigin Resource
Inst 0 : minTime
Inst 1:  maxTime

LimitsDelAggregation.label: LimitsDelAggregation
LimitsDelAggregation.description:
Contains the permitted settings of the DeliveryAggregation parameter of request primitives. 
'0' means 'False' '1' means 'True' '0 1' means 'False' or 'True'
